items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was thinking Louie Nelson went to some school... Louie Nelson? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, trombones.

ctx.x: I think a few of them you do know. You see, like Willard Hufford or one of your genius teachers. This fella Clyde. Who remember Clyde? He was teaching.
I remember for sure. I was thinking Louie Nelson went to some school, but I think he went to learn something else, he told us. Louie Nelson?
